```yaml
name: Update ingestr

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: update-ingestr
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  update-ingestr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Check for new ingestr version
        id: check
        run: |
          current=$(go list -m -f '{{.Version}}' ingestr)
          echo "current=$current" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          new=$(go list -m -u all | awk '/ingestr/ {print $3}')
          echo "new=$new" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update ingestr to latest
        if: steps.check.outputs.new != ''
        run: |
          go get ingestr@${{ steps.check.outputs.new }}
          go mod tidy

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.check.outputs.new != ''
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add go.mod go.sum
          git commit -m "chore: bump ingestr to ${{ steps.check.outputs.new }}"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/update-ingestr-${{ steps.check.outputs.new }}

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.check.outputs.new != ''
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump ingestr to ${{ steps.check.outputs.new }}"
          title: "chore: bump ingestr to ${{ steps.check.outputs.new }}"
          body: |
            This PR updates ingestr to the latest version ${{ steps.check.outputs.new }}.
          branch: update-ingestr-${{ steps.check.outputs.new }}
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
```
